features.quote: Once the detector is *highly* confident (severity ≥ threshold + 0.30, with ≥5 turns of evidence), the episode stops.
features.justification_quote: This truncates exactly the transcripts that are both most-clearly-degraded and most-expensive-to-continue.

features.quote: **No-progress stop.** If the model emits no valid tool call / no action for 3 consecutive turns ... stop
features.justification_quote: there's nothing left to measure and every further turn is wasted tokens.

features.quote: **`max_turns = 12`.** ... bounded. The single biggest determinant of per-run cost
features.justification_quote: The single biggest determinant of per-run cost; tunable per budget.
